content.short: Intersect is a member-based Cardano organization focused on ecosystem coordination, governance, and long-term stewardship.
content.description: Intersect is a member-based organization created to coordinate collaboration, governance participation, and long-term stewardship across the Cardano ecosystem. It brings together builders, operators, enterprises, and community contributors to discuss priorities, shape working groups, and support the maintenance and future direction of Cardano. Through member participation, committees, and ecosystem programs, Intersect provides structured coordination around proposals, collaboration, and shared decision-making.
